stories.title: Lula critica censura de Kassio a canal de Janones e diz desconfiar da Justiça Eleitoral

en.title: Lula criticizes Kassio's censorship of Janones' channel and says he distrusts Electoral Justice
en.summary: President Lula reacted to a decision by TSE minister Kassio Nunes Marques to suspend the "Exército do Lula" channel maintained by federal deputy André Janones, which has 3.3 million followers.

stories.title: 'Minha forma de dizer muito obrigado', diz Zé Vaqueiro sobre gravar DVD em Belém durante o Círio de Nazaré

en.title: 'My way of saying thank you', says Zé Vaqueiro about recording DVD in Belém during Círio de Nazaré
en.summary: Singer Zé Vaqueiro recorded a live audiovisual project in Belém during the Círio de Nazaré religious celebration, fulfilling a promise made in June and marking an important career moment.

stories.title: Mega-Sena 3069: aposta de Sergipe acerta a quina e leva R$ 26 mil; veja onde foi

en.title: Mega-Sena 3069: bet from Sergipe hits five numbers and wins R$ 26 thousand; see where it was
en.summary: A bet placed in Sergipe won five numbers in Mega-Sena draw 3069, earning a prize of R$ 26,095.22, while the jackpot of R$ 112 million went unclaimed and accumulated.

stories.title: Lula reclama de 'decisões tendenciosas' do TSE após decisão para derrubar canal nas redes

en.title: Lula complains about 'biased decisions' by TSE after decision to take down channel on social media
en.summary: President Lula called the TSE's decision to suspend the "Exército de Lula" WhatsApp channel absurd and complained about what he considers biased rulings from the electoral court.

stories.title: Nunes Marques manda derrubar canal 'Exército do Lula' nas redes

en.title: Nunes Marques orders removal of 'Exército do Lula' channel on social media
en.summary: Brazil's Electoral Court president ordered the suspension of a WhatsApp channel supporting President Lula, coordinated by elected deputy André Janones and having over 3 million subscribers. The order came in response to a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign.

stories.title: Mega-Sena acumula para R$ 150 milhões; confira os números sorteados

en.title: Mega-Sena jackpot accumulates to 150 million reais; check the drawn numbers
en.summary: No one matched all six numbers in Mega-Sena lottery draw 3,069, causing the jackpot to accumulate to an estimated 150 million reais for the next drawing. The winning numbers were 05, 19, 22, 44, 47, and 57.

stories.title: Kassio atende a pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro e manda censurar canal pró-Lula criado por Janones

en.title: Kassio grants Flávio Bolsonaro's request and orders censorship of pro-Lula channel created by Janones
en.summary: The Electoral Court president ordered WhatsApp to suspend a channel supporting President Lula within three hours of notification. The channel was administered by federal deputy André Janones.

stories.title: Corinthians anuncia Clarence Seedorf como novo técnico

en.title: Corinthians announces Clarence Seedorf as new coach
en.summary: Brazilian football club Corinthians announced the hiring of Clarence Seedorf as their new manager.

stories.title: 'Que Nossa Senhora nunca seja afastada de nós, nem por decreto', diz Fafá de Belém no Círio de Nazaré

en.title: 'May Our Lady never be taken from us, not even by decree', says Fafá de Belém at Círio de Nazaré
en.summary: Fafá de Belém made a statement during the Círio de Nazaré religious procession affirming that Our Lady should never be separated from Brazil through any official decree.

stories.title: Resultado da Mega-Sena 3069: confira as seis dezenas sorteadas neste domingo (11)

en.title: Mega-Sena 3069 results: check the six numbers drawn this Sunday (11)
en.summary: The lottery draw results for Mega-Sena 3069 held on Sunday featured six winning numbers.

stories.title: Aeroporto na Arábia Saudita continua fechado após ataque matar 12; houthis fazem mais ameaças

en.title: Saudi Arabian airport remains closed after attack kills 12; Houthis make further threats
en.summary: An attack on Riyadh's international airport left 12 people dead and over 309 injured, prompting airport closure while Yemeni Houthis issued new threats against Saudi airspace.

stories.title: Lula chama de 'tendenciosa' decisão de Kassio de derrubar grupo de Janones

en.title: Lula calls Kassio's decision to remove Janones group 'biased'
en.summary: President Lula criticized the TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques' decision to remove WhatsApp groups as biased, referring to groups supporting the reelection candidacy.

stories.title: Camilo Santana diz não ter dúvidas da aprovação do fim da 6x1 no Senado

en.title: Camilo Santana says he has no doubts about approval of end to 6x1 work schedule in Senate
en.summary: Senator Camilo Santana, political coordinator of Lula's reelection campaign, expressed confidence that the Senate will vote this week on ending the 6x1 work schedule. He did not specify how many votes the government would have for approval.

stories.title: Lula diz que votação do PEC do fim da escala 6x1 antes do segundo turno está ‘conversada’ com Alcolumbre

en.title: Lula says vote on constitutional amendment ending 6x1 work schedule before runoff is 'arranged' with Alcolumbre
en.summary: President Lula stated that the vote on ending the 6x1 work schedule before the election runoff is arranged with Senate president Davi Alcolumbre and challenged the opposition to demonstrate their position on the matter.

stories.title: Lula critica presidente do TSE e diz que partido vai pedir explicação sobre bloqueio a canal de Janones

en.title: Lula criticizes TSE president and says party will request explanation about blocking of Janones' channel
en.summary: President Lula criticized the Supreme Electoral Court president's decision to suspend a channel created by federal deputy André Janones and announced his party will seek explanations regarding what he characterized as biased decisions.

stories.title: Ministro da Secretaria de Comunicação vai se licenciar para se dedicar à campanha de Lula

en.title: Minister of Communication Secretariat will take leave to dedicate himself to Lula's campaign
en.summary: Communication Minister Sidônio Palmeira confirmed he will take leave starting Tuesday to dedicate himself to President Lula's reelection campaign. He previously served as Lula's campaign strategist in 2022.

stories.title: Nunes Marques atende pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro e suspende canal 'Exército do Lula'

en.title: Nunes Marques grants Flávio Bolsonaro's request and suspends 'Exército do Lula' channel
en.summary: Brazil's Superior Electoral Court president approved a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign to suspend a WhatsApp channel called 'Exército do Lula' that was created to support Lula's reelection bid. The court postponed a decision on suspending deputy André Janones's account pending further review.
